labels.name: Maisie's Galaxy
labels.note: One of the first z>11 galaxies spectroscopically confirmed by JWST; named after Finkelstein's daughter. Coords from name CEERS J141946.36+525632.8 (14:19:46.36, +52:56:32.8) - VERIFY against CEERS catalog.

labels.name: GN-z11
labels.note: Luminous z=10.6 galaxy, longtime distance record-holder pre-JWST; N-rich UV spectrum. Coords from 12:36:25.46 +62:14:31.4.

labels.name: CEERS-93316
labels.note: Famous z_phot~16.4 candidate later revised to a z=4.91 dusty galaxy - cautionary tale. Coords 14:19:39.48 +52:56:34.92.

labels.name: JADES-GS-z14-0
labels.ref: Carniani+2024; z spec refined by ALMA [OIII]88um (Carniani+2025, Schouws+2025)
labels.note: Current most-distant spectroscopically confirmed galaxy (z=14.18). Coords 03:32:19.905 -27:51:20.27.

labels.name: JADES-GS-z14-1
labels.note: Faintest spectroscopically confirmed galaxy at z~14. Coords 03:32:17.825 -27:53:09.34 (from designation). z 13.86-13.90 across papers.

labels.name: JADES-GS-z13-0
labels.note: One of first four z>10 galaxies spectroscopically confirmed by JWST; was distance record-holder 2022-2024. Coords 03:32:35.97 -27:46:35.4.

labels.name: JADES-GS-z11-0
labels.note: One of the original four Curtis-Lake z>10 confirmations. Coords from designation.

labels.name: JADES-GS-z13-1
labels.note: z~13 galaxy with strong Lyman-alpha damping-wing / possible Lyman-alpha; probes reionization. Coords 03:32:15.57 -27:53:23.29.

labels.name: MoM-z14
labels.ref: Naidu+2025 ('A Cosmic Miracle', Open J. Astrophys.)
labels.note: Most distant spectroscopically confirmed galaxy as of 2025 (z=14.44); first result from the 'Mirage or Miracle' survey in COSMOS. Coords 10:00:22.40 +02:16:23.19.

labels.name: GHZ1
labels.note: Bright z~9.9 galaxy behind Abell 2744, early GLASS-JWST z>10 candidate.

labels.name: UNCOVER-z13
labels.note: Lensed z~13 galaxy behind Abell 2744 (tentative spec confirmation via break).

labels.name: Abell2744-QSO1
labels.note: Prototypical 'little red dot' - a triply-lensed, reddened z=7.04 AGN with ~50M-solar SMBH; high BH-to-host mass ratio. Coords are brightest image A (Furtak+2025 Table 1); NASA press RA/Dec 00:14:18.25 -30:22:46.04 differs slightly (different image / centroid).

labels.name: CEERS 1019
labels.note: Hosted the most distant confirmed accreting SMBH at the time (z=8.68, 570 Myr after Big Bang); originally EGSY8p7. Coords 14:20:08.494 +52:53:26.

labels.name: CEERS-2112
labels.note: Most distant barred spiral galaxy found; a young Milky-Way analog / progenitor at z=3.

labels.name: Gz9p3
labels.note: Bright interacting/merging system at z=9.3 lensed by Abell 2744 periphery (mu~1.7). FIELD CORRECTION: it is A2744-lensed, NOT GOODS-N. One follow-up paper lists ~3.607, -30.381 (differs ~arcmin) - VERIFY exact centroid via MAST/NED.

labels.name: The Cliff
labels.note: Famous 'little red dot' in PRIMER-UDS with the strongest Balmer break yet seen plus broad H-alpha; the most notable nicknamed UDS object. Coords 02:17:38.58 -05:07:46.79.
